answer: Neighbor-quorum bonds stop bulk fakes. A newcomer claims one marble plot, locking 70. Five neighbors each sign a sonnet endorsing the claim, staking 30; none backs over three per epoch. At zenith, an auditor replays one in twenty endorsements. A rented sonnet or reused seal burns the bond and slashes endorsers. Filing starts 40, rising 6: 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 once and keep a full share.
